'''Atago Shrine''' (愛宕神社, ''Atago jinja'') is a [[Shinto]] shrine located in {{ill|Sendai|en|Sendai|qid=Q46747|lt=Sendai}}, {{ill|Miyagi Prefecture|en|Miyagi Prefecture|qid=Q47896|lt=Miyagi Prefecture}}, Japan. It enshrines the [[kami]] [[Kagu-tsuchi]] (軻遇土神), and its annual festival takes place on July 24.
